snippet.title: Daydream: Forgotten Sorrow – Release Date Trailer
snippet.description:
Are you ready to lose yourself in a beautiful and mysterious world filled with mind-bending puzzles? Look no further than Daydream: Forgotten Sorrow, the enchanting new puzzle adventure game launching on Steam on June 14th, with console releases soon to follow!

Add to wishlist on Steam: https://ravenage.ink/3G0S8tL

Daydream: Forgotten Sorrow is an atmospheric puzzle platformer game starring Griffin, a little boy who struggles to face his fears. Thankfully, his teddy bear companion Birly is always by his side.

In Daydream: Forgotten Sorrow, you'll journey through a world unlike any other, filled with stunning landscapes and intriguing secrets waiting to be uncovered. With its charming visuals and captivating storyline, this game is sure to leave you entranced from start to finish.

But the true magic of Daydream: Forgotten Sorrow lies in its puzzles. Each level will challenge you to think outside the box and use your problem-solving skills to overcome obstacles and unlock the game's deepest secrets. With each new puzzle, you'll feel a sense of accomplishment as you inch closer to uncovering the mysteries of this enchanting world.
So mark your calendars for May 24th and get ready to immerse yourself in the world of Daydream: Forgotten Sorrow. Whether you're a seasoned puzzle game player or new to the genre, this game is sure to provide you with hours of entertainment and wonder. Don't miss out on this unforgettable adventure!

Find Daydream: Forgotten Sorrow on social media:
► https://twitter.com/day_dream_game
► https://discord.gg/zap9pZ4k8k
► https://www.tiktok.com/@daydreamgame
► https://www.reddit.com/r/DayDreamGame
